y-m-33-09.s.s1.explain: (a+b)² = a²+b²+2ab, 16 = 6 + 2ab, sidaa darteed ab = 5. Kadibna a³+b³ = (a+b)³ − 3ab(a+b) = 64 − 3·5·4 = 4.

y-m-33-09.s.s2.line.0: (a+b)² = 16, tanina waa a² + b² + 2ab, sidaa darteed 16 = 6 + 2ab, taasi waa, ab = 5.
y-m-33-09.s.s2.line.3: Sidaa darteed waxaa jira tirooyin dhab ah a iyo b oo isugeyntoodu tahay 4 isugeynta labajibbaarradooduna tahay 6, isugeynta jibbaarradooduna tahay 4.
y-m-33-09.s.s2.explain: Waa sadarka 4aad. Saddexda sadar ee ugu horreeya dhammaantood si sax ah ayaa loo xisaabiyey. Laakiin sadarka 3aad (a−b)² wuxuu soo baxay −4, labajibbaarka tiro dhab ah na waa 0 ama ka badan. Sidaa darteed tirooyin dhab ah a iyo b oo buuxiya shuruudaha ma jiraan. Qiimaha 4 waa natiijo xisaab rasmi ah oo keliya oo ku salaysan mala-awaalka ah inay jiraan tirooyin dhab ah oo noocaas ah.

y-m-33-09.s.s3.r.d: Waxaad seegtay qodobka ah in jiritaanku sii adkaado marka qiimuhu sii yaraado. Waad ogaan kartaa adigoo hubinaya (a−b)².
y-m-33-09.s.s3.explain: Ha noqoto a²+b²=s, ab=(16−s)/2 iyo (a−b)² = s − 2ab = 2s − 16. Si qiimahan u noqdo 0 ama ka badan, s ≥ 8 ayaa loo baahan yahay. 8 iyo 10 waa suurtagal (8 oo leh a=b=2), 7 iyo 5 na (a−b)² waa taban, sidaa darteed suurtagal ma aha.
